Both orders establish a presidential policy body composed of a chairman and presidentially designated members, assign it a study-and-recommendation mission with enumerated subjects, direct executive agencies to cooperate and furnish information, provide nearly identical travel-expense language, and use substantially identical fiscal-year 1950/1951 Emergency Fund financing and statutory-waiver machinery. This extensive parallel sequence and distinctive language far exceed generic board-creation boilerplate. C03 and C12 have some similar committee machinery but lack C04's unusually close compensation, funding, and provision-by-provision correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby created a board to be known as the President's Communications Policy Board which shall be composed of a chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President a Commission which shall be known as the President's Water Resources Policy Commission, and which shall be composed of a Chairman and six other members to be designated by the President.","explanation":"Nearly identical opening machinery creates a named presidential body consisting of a chairman and additional presidentially designated members."},{"child_excerpt":"It shall be the function of the Board to study ... and to make and present to the President evaluations and recommendations ... concerning (a) ... (b) ... (c) ... and (d) such related policy matters as the Board may determine.","parent_excerpt":"The President's Water Resources Policy Commission shall study, and make recommendations to the President with respect to ... The Commission shall give consideration in particular to (a) ... (b) ... (c) ... and (d) ...","explanation":"Both second provisions define a study-and-recommendation mission and organize its scope into four lettered subjects."},{"child_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Board in its work and to furnish the Board such information as it may require in the performance of its duties.","parent_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance as it may require in the performance of its duties.","explanation":"The cooperation clause is virtually verbatim, with only the body's name and the addition of “assistance” differing."},{"child_excerpt":"Each member of the Board shall, while away from his home or regular place of business and engaged in the official business of the Board, receive actual traveling actual traveling expenses and per-diem allowances in lieu of subsistence in accordance with the rates established by the Standardized Government Travel Regulations, as amended.","explanation":"The child's travel provision closely reproduces C04's phrasing and administrative mechanism, omitting only compensation."},{"child_excerpt":"During the fiscal year 1950 the expenditures of the Board and the fiscal year 1951. Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... other laws as the President may hereafter specify.","parent_excerpt":"During the fiscal year 1950, the compensation of the members of the Commission (including traveling expenses and per-diem allowances) and the expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation appearing under the heading \"Emergency Fund for the President\" in the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1950 ...; and during the fiscal year 1951 such compensation and expenditures shall be similarly paid from any corresponding or like appropriation made available for the fiscal year 1951. Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... such other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify.","explanation":"This distinctive, detailed financing provision is substantially the same in both directives, strongly indicating literal reuse and adaptation."}]}
